## **6\. Privacy, Security and Confidentiality**

Neither party can disclose any confidential information of the other party, or use it outside of obligations under these ToS, without explicit written permission. Any information disclosed without fault, already lawfully owned, publicly accessible, received from a third party with apparent disclosure rights, or ordered by a court or subpoena to be produced, is exempt from this rule. For example, a good indicator that material is considered confidential is if the word Confidential is featured prominently in the header or footer.

This information is restricted to the absolute minimum of transactional details necessary for the operation of Our Partner Program and does not include Content or End-User Personal Data.

## **8\. Change or Suspension of Service**

Ideanote may suspend or terminate access to its Service with advanced written notice solely for the following reasons: (i) planned maintenance, (ii) unavoidable disruptions, (iii) non-compliance with these terms provided that notice of the non-compliance is provided to Customer, and Customer has not cured such noncompliance within 30 days, (iv) outstanding payments provided that notice of the overdue payment is provided to Customer, and Customer has not paid outstanding payments within 30 days, or security risks.

Neither party is liable for failure to perform due to "Force Majeure", such as any unforeseeable circumstances that are beyond the reasonable control of Ideanote, including, but not limited to, an act of nature, act of government, flood, fire, earthquake, civil unrest, act of terror, strike or other labor problem (not involving Ideanote employees), failure or delay of internet service providers or telecommunications, Non-Ideanote Applications, or the actions of third parties, including without limitation, denial of service attacks or significant third-party service provider failures.

During any Force Majeure Event, Ideanote shall be exempt from performing its obligations under this Agreement to the extent that Ideanote's ability to perform is prevented, restricted, or interfered with. Ideanote shall notify the Customer without undue delay, providing details of the Force Majeure Event and its potential impact on its performance. Ideanote will use reasonable efforts to resolve any issues arising from the Force Majeure Event and resume the performance of its obligations as swiftly as possible.

Notwithstanding the foregoing, if a Force Majeure Event extends for more than 30 days, either Party may terminate this Agreement without penalty, upon providing written notice to the other Party.

The performance of these ToS shall then be suspended for as long as any such event will prevent the affected party from performing its required obligations under these ToS.

## **9\. Termination**

This Agreement starts on the Effective Date and remains in effect as long as the Customer has an active Subscription unless it’s terminated as per the Agreement's terms. If the Agreement is terminated, all active Order Forms are also terminated. However, ending a single Order Form doesn’t affect the Agreement or other Order Forms.

When the Agreement ends, all licenses granted to the Customer by Ideanote are revoked. Termination by either party does not prevent other legal actions or release either party from liabilities for breaches that occurred before termination. Termination according to the Agreement's terms does not result in damage liability for either party.

After termination, Customer Data can be retrieved for 30 days. After this period, Ideanote may delete the data without further obligation. If termination is due to Ideanote’s unresolved material breach, a pro-rated refund of Subscription Fees for services not provided will be issued. For all other termination reasons, any outstanding Subscription Fees up to the end of the Subscription Term must be paid within ten days of termination.

After termination, all rights granted to You under these Terms will end, but any outstanding payments will still be due.

## **10\. Relationship and Assignment**

Our relationship with You is not a partnership, employment, or agency relationship.

The Parties agree that they operate independently and neither Party has the right or authority to assume or create any obligation or responsibility on behalf of the other Party.

You cannot transfer this Agreement to another party without Ideanote's written permission, and any attempt without consent is invalid. However, both parties can transfer the Agreement to a related entity or during significant corporate changes, such as mergers, acquisitions, restructures, or sales of most assets tied to this Agreement. If You are the Customer, You must follow Ideanote's specific procedure to assign the ToS. These ToS legally benefits and obligates both parties and any approved successors or assignees. Ideanote has the right to terminate these Terms if such successor is a competitor of Ideanote.

## **11\. Survival of Terms**

You agree that the provisions of these ToS that (by their nature) should survive termination will indeed survive any termination of these ToS. Any termination by either of the parties or the expiry of the term of these ToS shall only have effect for the future, and shall have no retroactive effects.

## **12\. Severability**

If any provision of this Agreement shall be found by any court or administrative body of competent jurisdiction to be invalid or unenforceable the invalidity or unenforceability of such provision shall not affect the other provisions of this Agreement and all provisions not affected by such invalidity or unenforceability shall remain in full force and effect.

## **12\. No Waiver**

If Ideanote does not explicitly exercise a particular right under these ToS, that does not waive them.

## **13\. Export Restrictions**

The Services are subject to U.S. and international export control and economic sanctions laws such as the SDN List. You agree to comply with these laws regarding the use of the Services. You confirm that neither You nor any controlling entities are on any restricted-party lists. You will not, nor allow others to Use the Services in countries under U.S. embargo or sanction lists, use the Services if You or any users are on restricted-party lists, store information in the Services that falls under U.S. arms control laws or similar regulations or use the Services for purposes prohibited by U.S. or other relevant import and export laws.

We're not liable if government actions restrict access to the Services, and You recognize access is not guaranteed in jurisdictions with such restrictions. We reserve the right to refuse or terminate contracts based on export control restrictions, embargoes, sanctions, or legal considerations.

## **14\. Entire Agreement**

These ToS, including documents included by reference, are the complete agreement between You and Ideanote, unless other specific terms apply.

## **15\. Counterparts**

These ToS may be executed in any number of counterparts, each of which shall be considered an original, but all of which together will constitute one and the same instrument.

## **16\. Disclaimer of Warranty**

We do Our best to build and operate a Service to high standards but We can not guarantee everything. Our Service will conform with any specifications, descriptions, or documentation that We provide You. Our Service shall not violate laws applicable to the Service or Our ordinary course of business.

Except as expressly set forth in this Section, to the fullest extent possible by law, Our Service is provided “as is” without any representations or warranties, express or implied. In other words, Ideanote is always in beta. Ideanote makes no representations or warranties in relation to Our Service, its fitness for a certain purpose or the information and materials provided through Our Service. 

You agree that the Service may be updated andmodified at any time with prior written notice provided such modification does not materially degrade the performance of Our Services.

## **17\. Limitation of Liability**

You understand and agree that Ideanote or any entity involved in creating, producing or distributing the Service will not under any circumstances be liable for any indirect or consequential damages, including, without limitation, lost profits, incidental, special, or punitive damages arising out of the use of or inability to use or access of the Service and Content on it.

Ideanote is not liable for the defamatory, offensive or illegal conduct of other people or third parties and that the risk of injury from these causes of actions rests entirely with You.

Ideanote is not liable for any loss, damage, fees or misconduct resulting from unauthorized access of Your account to the extent such access is caused by failure on Your side to safeguard the access to Your Account. 

Neither Ideanote nor any of its affiliates, information providers or other third-party providers or partners are liable regardless of the cause or duration, for any errors, inaccuracies, omissions, or other defects in, or untimeliness of, the information contained within the Service or Content on the Service. No part of Our Service constitutes, or is meant to constitute, advice of any kind. If You require advice in relation to any legal or financial matter You should consult an appropriate professional.

Ideanote may fully cooperate with any valid and binding law enforcement requests or directing Ideanote to disclose confidential or private information or Content of any Account or Customer. You understand and agree that Ideanote or any entity involved in creating, producing or distributing the Service will not under any circumstances be liable for any damages, including, without limitation, lost profits, direct, indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive damages arising out of such requests.

Any breach of the Acceptable Use Policy with material consequences for Ideanote will make You liable for damages suffered by Ideanote and other people that it might cause harm to.

If Ideanote is found liable for any event or circumstance resulting from these ToS with You, Our liability cannot exceed the amount invoiced to You by Us during the course of the last twelve (12) months.

## **18\. Indemnification**

You agree to defend, indemnify and hold harmless Ideanote, its affiliates and their respective directors, officers, employees and agents from and against all claims and expenses, including attorneys’ fees, arising out of Your use of Ideanote.

You are fully liable if Content You create is infringing upon third party rights, and You accordingly agree to indemnify Ideanote for all claims and losses related to such infringement. You acknowledge that the provisions of this section shall apply to all Content on the Service.

## **19\. Governing Law**

These ToS are governed by Danish law, and any disputes will be handled in Denmark. Disputes and arbitrations with Ideanote must be handled individually, not as part of a group or class action.

## **20\. Dispute Resolution**

We would prefer to avoid legal disputes. If You are contemplating a claim, try to resolve it informally with Us for 21 days before initiating formal proceedings. Contact Us with "Dispute Notice" as the subject line, and We will strive to find a solution within that period. If unsuccessful, either party may proceed formally.

Any disputes related to Our Terms of Service will be resolved via arbitration overseen by The Danish Institute of Arbitration following their current rules. The proceedings, which will be held in Copenhagen, Denmark, will consist of a single arbitrator and will be conducted in English.

All disputes, except for those qualifying for small claims court, will be resolved through binding arbitration instead of in a court by a judge or jury.

## **21\. Change**

We reserve the right to adjust and change these ToS and supplementary Terms at any time. If a change is material We will let You know in advance.

## **22\. Notice and Contact**

Notices will be sent to Your registered email.

You can contact Us at [legal@ideanote.io](mailto:legal@ideanote.io)

# **Privacy Policy**

The Privacy Policy below (“Privacy Policy”) supplements and amends the Ideanote Terms of Service (“ToS”). If there is any conflict between this Privacy Policy and the Terms of Service, the applicable terms in the Privacy Policy will prevail.

## **1\. General**

We are committed to maintaining robust privacy protections for people using Our Services. Our Privacy Policy is designed to help You understand how We collect, use and safeguard the information You provide to Us and to assist You in making informed decisions when using Our Services. By accepting Our Privacy Policy, You consent to Our collection, storage, use and disclosure of Your personal information as described in this Privacy Policy.

We reserve the right to adjust and change this Privacy Policy at any time. If a change is material we will let you know in advance. By continuing to use Ideanote after the effective date, you agree to the new version.

## **2\. Information We Collect**

### **2.1 Personal Data We Collect and Receive**

We gather both "Non-Personal" and "Personal Information."

Non-Personal Information comprises data that doesn't identify you, such as usage trends, demographic info, and website navigation details.

Personal Information refers to details you provide during registration, including your email, phone number, and name. You can also add more information at your discretion. If you're representing a company, you may use its name as identification. To update any incorrect or incomplete data, visit the "Settings" on our website or contact us directly.

The personal information we collect varies based on your interactions, choices, and the features you use on our website and can include the following:

#### **2.1.1 for End-users**

We may collect the following personal data for end-users of Customers

##### **End-user Registration and Contact Information**

  * End-user Name
  * End-user Email



##### **End-user Service Data**

  * End-user IP
  * End-user URL
  * End-user Referrer
  * End-user Browser
  * End-user Device
  * End-user Events
  * End-user Settings



##### **End-user Content**

All data and information submitted by End-users to the Services and includes message text, files, comments and links, but does not include third-party products or the Service.

#### **2.1.2 for Customers**

We may collect the following personal data from Customers.

##### **Customer Personal Information**

  * Customer Contact Name
  * Customer Contact Email



##### **Customer Payment Information:**

  * Credit Card Details
  * Customer Contact IP
  * Customer Address



## **3\. Cookies**

In an effort to improve the quality of the Website, We track information provided to Us by Your browser, such as the website You came from (known as the “referring URL”), the type of browser You use, the device from which You connected to any of Our Website, the time and date of access, and other information that does not personally identify You. We track this information using cookies or small text files which include an anonymous unique identifier. This allows Us to collect Non-Personal information about you, such as keeping a record of your theme preferences.

Do Not Track. Some Internet browsers may be configured to send "Do Not Track" signals to the online services that you visit. We currently do not respond to "Do Not Track" or similar signals. To find out more about "Do Not Track," please visit[ http://www.allaboutdnt.com](http://www.allaboutdnt.com).

We may use both persistent and session cookies. Persistent cookies remain on Your computer or any of your other devices after You close Your session and until You delete them, or until they expire automatically. Session cookies expire when You close Your browser. For a list of the Cookies used in Our Website, please view Our Cookies Policy.

## **4\. Use of Personal Information**

We don't sell or trade your Personal Information to third parties without your consent. However, we do share it with vendors performing services for us. For instance, your email may be shared with an external vendor for sending emails on our behalf. All vendors are instructed to use your Personal Information strictly as we direct and are selected based on their compliance with our privacy and security standards. Note that some services may require transferring your data to U.S.-based servers.

For business analytics purposes, we utilize Google Ads conversion tracking exclusively for workspace owners at the moment of their first upgrade. This tracking is limited to a single instance to measure and improve the effectiveness of our upgrade processes. This use of Google Ads is crucial for our business to understand customer upgrade behavior and has minimal impact on your privacy, as it is a one-time action during the upgrade process.

We primarily use your Personal Information to communicate with you and enhance our website's user experience. This could involve contacting you for feedback, technical support, or to share promotional offers in line with your preferences. You can opt out of our marketing emails at any time.

Other uses include delivering targeted advertising, administering prize draws and competitions, protecting our website's security, enabling user-to-user communications, responding to legal requests, managing user accounts, providing requested services, offering support and responding to inquiries,  
  
For other business purposes, we may use aggregated and anonymized data that can't be linked to individual users.

## **5\. Use of Non-Personal Information**

In general, We use Non-Personal Information to help Us improve Our Website and customize Your experience. We also aggregate Non-Personal Information in order to track trends and analyze usage patterns on Our Website. 

## **6\. Transfer of Information**

### **6.1 Ideanote Group Companies:**

Your data may be shared within the Ideanote ApS corporate family to improve our services.

### **6.2 Service Providers:**

Consultants and vendors engaged by us to support our provision of the Ideanote Services and Sites and the operation of our business and third-party sub-processors.

### **6.3 Advertising Partners**

Third party advertising companies may use cookies and similar technologies to collect information about your activity on the Ideanote Website and other online services over time to serve you online targeted advertisements, including the companies listed in the third-party cookies section of our Cookie Policy.

### **6.4 Professional Advisors**

Professional advisors, such as lawyers, auditors and insurers, in the course of the professional services that they render to us.

### **6.5 Compliance With Law Enforcement**

  * Comply with applicable laws, lawful requests, and legal process, such as to respond to subpoenas or requests from government authorities;
  * Protect our, your or others’ rights, privacy, safety or property (including by making and defending legal claims);
  * Enforce the terms and conditions that govern Our Website; and
  * Prevent, identify, investigate and deter fraudulent, harmful, unauthorized, unethical or illegal activity, including cyberattacks and identity theft.



### **6.6 Business Transfers**

In the event that We undergo a business transaction such as a merger, acquisition by another company, or sale of all or a portion of Our assets, Your Personal Information may be among the assets transferred. You acknowledge and consent that such transfers may occur and are permitted by this Privacy Policy, and that any acquirer of Our assets may continue to process Your Personal Information as set forth in this Privacy Policy.

### **6.7 Aggregated or Anonymized Information.**

We reserve the right to share aggregated or anonymized data with third parties and publicly. This data does not personally identify you, but includes general usage and technical metrics. If required by law to treat this as personal data, we will disclose it as outlined above; otherwise, it may be disclosed for any reason.

### **6.8 Third Party Websites**

The Sites may also contain links to third party websites. This Privacy Policy applies solely to information processed by us. You should contact the relevant third party websites for more information about how your personal data is processed by them.

### 6.9 Workspace Owner Data and Cross-Regional Transfers

To ensure performance of our contract with Customers—including account support, billing, compliance, and service continuity—we may transfer limited workspace owner data (such as workspace name and associated business contact email) across regions, even in cases where the workspace is hosted under a regional data residency setup. These transfers enable us to provide essential services, such as identifying unusual activity, offering assistance, or sharing important updates about your subscription. Such processing is based on our legitimate interest in supporting Customers and the contractual necessity of managing the service effectively.

## **7\. Retention**

We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes set out in this Privacy Policy. If you would like more information about specific retention periods please contact legal@ideanote.io.

## **8\. How We Protect Information**

We implement security measures designed to protect Your information from unauthorized access. Your account is protected by Your account password and We urge You to take steps to keep Your personal information safe by not disclosing Your password and by logging out of Your Account after each use. 

We further protect Your information from potential security breaches by implementing certain technological security measures including encryption, firewalls and secure socket layer technology. However, these measures do not guarantee that Your information will not be accessed, disclosed, altered or destroyed by a breach of such firewalls and/or secure server software. You can read more about our security measures at[ https://ideanote.io/legal/security-questionnaire](https://ideanote.io/legal/security-questionnaire).

## **9\. Your Privacy Rights**

Depending on your location and subject to applicable laws, you may have certain data protection rights. We respect those rights. We will need to verify your identity to process your information, access, and deletion requests. These rights are not absolute, and in some instances, we may decline your request as permitted by law.

## **10\. Privacy and Age**

Our Website and Sites are not intended for use by anyone under the age of 16. Ideanote does not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under the age of 16. If you are under 16, you may not attempt to register for Our Website or send any information about yourself to us, including your name, address, telephone number, or email address. 

If we become aware that we have collected personal information from someone under the age of 16 without verification of parental consent, we will delete that information promptly. If you are a parent or legal guardian of a child under 16 and believe that a child has provided us with their personal information, please contact us at the email or mailing address provided at the end of this Privacy Policy.

## **11\. Changes**

We may amend this Privacy Policy from time to time in response to changing legal, technical or business developments. When we update it, we will take appropriate measures to inform you, consistent with the significance of the changes we make.

## **12\. Communication**

We might choose to communicate with You via electronic means (e.g. SMS, chat, emails), via post and via telephone calls.

Ideanote will not forward marketing material from third parties to You. If You choose to contact Our customer service we retain the right to write back, call or otherwise contact You back.

We might forward notifications about activity on any of Our Website, that We deem relevant for You, to Your e-mail or as a Push Notification. 

We will forward product news, contests or useful information on how to use our product that we deem relevant to Your use of Our Website as We see fit. You can opt out of communication sent to You by unsubscribing from Our emails or by contacting us directly.

## **13\. Contact**

If you have any questions, comments or concerns about the way your personal data is being used or processed by Ideanote, please submit any questions, comments or concerns in writing to our Data Protection Officer at dpo@ideanote.io.

For general questions you can also reach out to legal@ideanote.io

# Intro to the Innovation-Led Growth Framework

Innovation has shifted. It used to be top-down, closed off, and owned by a small group of people at the top. 

Now it's collaborative, visible, and spread across entire organizations.

To succeed you'll need a more **efficient** , more **straightforward** , and **engaging** process to stay on top of the game.

At Ideanote, we are acutely aware of this shift and have crafted our Innovation-Led Growth Framework accordingly. It places innovation at the heart of growth strategy and ensures that it is woven into your organization's DNA.

The Framework, the Flywheel, and the Principles that connect them give you a complete system for making innovation something your organization does reliably, not something it hopes for.

Join us in embracing the future of innovation and creating impact together.

## Open Sourced Tools for Innvators

Enhance your innovation strategy with our comprehensive suite of free tools designed to streamline idea management and foster creativity within your organization. 

Our AI-powered solutions, including the AI Idea Generator, AI Flywheel Coach, and AI Pitch Ideanote, are tailored to assist businesses in capturing, developing, and implementing innovative ideas effectively. These user-friendly tools are suitable for companies across various industries, aiming to boost employee engagement, drive growth, and maintain a competitive edge in today's dynamic market.

### Benefits

  * **User-Friendly Interface:** Our tools are designed for quick onboarding and ease of use
  * **Customization:** Tailor the tools to meet your organization's unique requirements and personal preferences.
  * **Cross-Industry Application:** Suitable for various sectors, including manufacturing, healthcare, and finance, our tools adapt to your industry's specific challenges and opportunities.



### Frequently asked Questions

Are these innovation tools free to use?

Yes, these innovation tools are offered for free to support businesses and individuals in boosting their innovation processes, making growth and transformation more achievable.

Who can benefit from this toolbox?

These tools are ideal for corporate leaders, innovation managers, creative teams, and anyone involved in driving business growth through innovative solutions. They help simplify and enhance the process of idea generation, strategy development, and presenting business cases.

How do I use these tools?

To start, simply select the tool you wish to use, fill in the necessary information or inputs as prompted, and let the AI generate the output, whether it’s a set of ideas, strategic guidance, or a tailored pitch.

Are all of these tools included in Ideanote?

Ideanote comes jam-packed with [idea management and innovation features](/feature). That being said, not all of the resources above are available inside the Ideanote app. Some of them are downloads or more built for strategic advice beyond the Ideanote app itself.

# Drive Growth   
with Innovation

Ideanote is your central home for ideas. It helps drive innovation-led growth for businesses of all sizes.  
We experienced the real pain of trying to share and action ideas inside of companies.   
  
A 10-page paper form or excel sheet can not be the answer.

OUR STORY

## Make Ideas Matter

It’s 2014. A set of twins, Rune and Andreas Mehlsen, have just sold their App Store trending game to a Danish publishing house and are standing in its entrance hall.   
  
They’re blissful and they’ve already got the next idea.They look to their left. A grey wall. They look to their right. A dark corridor that reeks of an this-is-how-we’ve-always-done-it culture.  
  
They look ahead. A helpful colleague hands them a 10 page paper form titled “Submit your Idea” with the words, “They’ll get back to you within a year”.  
  
We will never know what idea the two Mehlsen twins had that day. It was lost in the fog of an outdated corporate [innovation culture](https://ideanote.io/blog/successful-innovation-culture). But, in its place, the spark of Ideanote was born.

2015

Year Founded

110+

A GLOBAL CHALLENGE

## Everyone wants to Innovate

There is a growing disconnect between how many companies want to have an innovation process that delivers and how many do.  
  
Despite 93 percent of executives seeing organic growth through innovation as the most important driver of future revenue, 59 percent of all companies have not implemented a formal process for ideas.  
  
Complex platforms, insane prices and a consultant heavy approach to implementation are stopping companies and managers from delivering on their innovation goals.  
  
Removing the barriers to implementing actionable [idea and innovation](https://ideanote.io/blog/definition-idea-innovation-and-many-more) management helps more new businesses get started, expedites growth for existing companies, and helps make more of the right ideas matter, globally

OUR COMPANY

## We believe in making ideas matter

We're a product company.  
  
We're building the world's first innovation-led growth platform so teams and companies can collect, develop and act on the best ideas from employees and customers without any of the busywork.  
  
By combining idea collection, idea management, engagement and impact analytics in one single and easy to use platform Ideanote democratizes access to the tools of innovation.  
  
Businesses of every size — from new startups to public companies — use our software to power their innovation.

OUR PLATFORM

## Ideas? Ideanote.

You can think of Ideanote like a collaborative workspace where people come together to collect, develop and implement more of the right ideas.  
  
Ideanote give you a place to structure your innovation process and build your own goal-driven innovation engine — while saving time on repetitive tasks with smart workflow automation an AI.  


OUR METHOD

## Innovation-Led Growth

Being able to stay innovative in the global marketplace is more important than ever, but the expectations, routines and decentralized nature of work means it's harder than ever to make sure the right ideas are heard and moved forward.  
  
That's why we created the world's first Innovation-Led Growth platform — to help businesses stay agile and competitive.   
  
With platform that makes innovation easy to get started with and efficient for everyone.
